request: Ensuring a provider service relay's network connections must succeed when the relay container is already connected to the network, for example because a concurrent run connected it first.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(relay): tolerate a concurrent network connect race

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > pkg/compose/relay_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestEnsureRelayNetworksTreatsAlreadyConnectedAsSuccess)$' ./pkg/compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
